RankSelector = Callable[[Sequence[Sequence[int]]], int]

@dataclass
class _PrefixStats:
    hits: int = 0
    rank_hits: defaultdict[int, int] = field(
        default_factory=lambda: defaultdict(int)
    )

    def record(self, rank: int) -> None:
        self.hits += 1
        self.rank_hits[rank] += 1
